Hi Alex —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood. Per our kickoff call I wanted to start a short thread to coordinate the technical handoff for access controls: SSO (SAML), SCIM provisioning, IP allowlists, and the service-account pattern we recommend for CI systems.

Proposed 2-week sprint cadence:
- Week 0: confirm SAML attributes + metadata exchange
- Week 1: SCIM mapping + test provisioning to staging
- Week 2: IP allowlist cutover and service account rollout to prod

Can you confirm:
1) Who on your side will own SAML metadata and the IdP test tenant? (name/email)
2) Do you require any non-standard SAML attributes (eg. employeeNumber / eduPersonPrincipalName)?
3) Any firewall/egress constraints we should account for (eg. only specific egress IPs)?

Attached: onboarding-checklist.xlsx (staged tasks), scim-schema-example.json (sample mapping), ip-allowlist-template.txt (format for firewall team).

If that cadence works I’ll schedule 30m twice-weekly check-ins and share a short mutual action plan doc.

Thanks —

Hi Alex / Kim —

Quick technical notes from the infra side to unblock testing:

1) SAML / Metadata
- SP metadata: I’m attaching the ACS and metadata endpoints (see checklist link). We support NameID as persistent and emailAddress by default. ePPN (eduPersonPrincipalName) is supported if you include it in the assertion; we'll accept it as the unique identifier for a user.

2) SCIM mapping and provisioning
- We can map "employee_id" to our internal user.id field. In scim-schema-example.json you’ll find the example mapping section:
  - external.employee_id -> user.externalId
  - external.email -> user.emails[0].value
  - external.title -> user.title
  - external.manager -> user.manager

- For provisioning callbacks our staging endpoints are ip-restricted; we accept provisioning from the IP ranges in ip-allowlist-template.txt. If you need to send a one-off IP for your HR feed, add it to the template and we’ll approve in 24 hours.

3) Service accounts
- Recommended pattern: create a dedicated service account per CI pipeline with least privilege OAuth token for provisioning and role assignment. We will issue scoped API keys (not full admin keys) and log all service account activity in the audit log.

4) Test plan
- Step A: Exchange metadata + test SAML sign-on to staging (target: day 2)
- Step B: Create 3 test users via SCIM, verify provisioning + group sync (target: day 4)
- Step C: IP allowlist dry-run with your firewall team (target: day 7)

Attachments referenced: scim-schema-example.json, ip-allowlist-template.txt (attached to the checklist).

If you can confirm the egress IPs and the HR field mapping we’ll kick off staging work on Monday.

Ben Carter
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
